Business model

Users first, then we sell the looks

Phase 1 · 2027 · users
Free

looks + item links

GEL 0.5

per AI try-on photo

To win users, we publish the looks with free links to every item. A man finds the look he wants, tries it on, and buys the items he’s missing through each store’s own link.

➜
Phase 2 · from late 2027 · pilot sales
~30%

target gross margin per look

~70%

of retail to suppliers

If Georgia proves demand, we start selling looks ourselves as a limited pilot, then integrate suppliers in 2028. A women’s line is planned for 2028.

Price, margin and timing are plan assumptions. The ~30% is gross margin, before delivery, returns, payment fees and support. No supplier has agreed to 70/30. LC Waikiki is in talks; nothing is signed.

$1.5M covers $38K of set-up costs and about 20 months of the planned $72.8K a month, before any sales. Hiring in stages makes the real burn lower. GEL 2.62 = $1.
What the $1.5M proves

Three things, in Georgia first

1

Demand

Men open looks, click items, pay for try-on and come back. Measured as a funnel and in monthly cohorts.

2

Commerce

Written supplier terms, the basket after men untick what they own, and the cost of delivery and partial returns in a pilot.

3

Repeatable growth

The full cost of winning a user, content and team included, paid back by purchases and repeat use.

Then a seed round, sized on these results, to scale into new markets.
Funnel targets are set from the first months of data. No user, revenue or sales results are claimed yet.

Appendix · Runway

How far $1.5M goes

($1,500,000 − $38,000 set-up)÷ $72,800 a month≈ 20 months
24 months at the full budget≈ $1.785M≈ $285K short

The levers

Hire in stages as tests pass, so the real burn starts well under $72.8K a month. Try-on revenue and pilot sales extend the runway further.

What we don’t claim

That $1.5M covers all of 2027–2028 without sales. The calendar runway also depends on when the round closes and spending starts.

$72.8K a month is the planned budget for a team of up to 13, not today’s spend.
